summary: Tested Trading Dashboard backend (auth + dashboard metrics) and frontend (login, KPIs, filters, logout). All 10 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend renders all KPIs/charts/tables; month/day/period filters correctly update data; logout works.

issues: Recharts logs transient width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial render before container measures; cosmetic only, charts render correctly afterward. Consider setting min-height on ResponsiveContainer parent.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py imports `from server import db` lazily inside get_current_user — works but creates a circular dependency risk; consider moving db init to a separate module.
/api/dashboard/metrics fetches ALL trades into memory then filters in Python. Fine for ~781 records but won't scale; recommend MongoDB aggregation pipeline if dataset grows.
MEP Líquido is mocked as fixed 40/30/20/10 split of lucro_liquido (server.py L204-209) — confirm with PO that this is intended placeholder vs real grouping.
secure=False on auth cookies (server.py L48-49) is OK for preview env but must be True in production HTTPS.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec; browsers may reject. Set explicit origins for production.
seed_data_creation: Admin user auto-seeded on startup; trades collection seeded via existing seed (781 ops, 3 months).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth + dashboard. Reuse for regression. Login is pre-filled with admin creds in Login.js for convenience.
